meta.name: opportunity-solution-tree
meta.description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将利益相关者请求转化为可验证的解决方案树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在决定构建什么之前先对需求进行问题框架分析
copy.tagline_en: Transform stakeholder requests into a verifiable solution tree
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame problems before deciding what to build

howto.what: 引导你从利益相关者请求出发，提取目标结果，生成机会（要解决的问题）、解决方案和实验，并基于可行性、影响和市场需求推荐最优概念验证（POC）。最终输出机会-解决方案树（OST）和POC计划。
howto.when: 当你有一个利益相关者请求或产品想法，需要先框定问题再决定构建什么时，或者你想澄清模糊目标、排定问题优先级时触发。

say.text: 我们想提升免费版转付费率，帮我做机会解决方案树。
say.note: Claude将引导你提取目标结果并构建OST。

say.text: 销售要求开发移动端，因为竞品都有。先做OST分析。
say.note: Claude会帮你框定问题，避免直接跳入解决方案。

say.text: 需要为新功能做发现，但需求不清晰，用OST帮我梳理。
say.note: Claude会逐步询问并生成机会与方案。

howto.what_en: Guides you to extract a target outcome from a stakeholder request, generate opportunities (problems to solve), map solutions and experiments, then recommend the best proof-of-concept (POC) based on feasibility, impact, and market fit. Outputs an Opportunity Solution Tree (OST) and POC plan.
howto.when_en: Use when you have a stakeholder request or product idea that needs problem framing before deciding what to build, or when you need to clarify vague goals, prioritize problems, or align the team on outcomes.

say_en.text: We want to increase free-to-paid conversion, let's build an OST.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through extracting the outcome and building the tree.

say_en.text: Sales wants a mobile app because competitors have one. Do an OST first.
say_en.note: Claude helps frame the problem before jumping to solutions.

say_en.text: Need discovery for a new feature but requirements are unclear. Use OST to structure.
say_en.note: Claude will ask step-by-step questions to generate opportunities and solutions.
